thread:
incident-bot: P1 — Elevated inference latency detected in us-east. Paging oncall @evelyn_t. Alerts: 95th latency up, error rate rising. Warroom: https://goto.re/redwood/warroom/7065432100 :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Alerts summary: model=redwood-3b, region=us-east, 95p latency 2.3s (baseline 0.4s), 504 errors 5% for last 5m. Autoscaler activity: thrash seen.

Evelyn_t: On it, joining warroom now. Assigning owner. I'll lead mitigation.

Jamal_r: I'll pull autoscaler + kvcache metrics. Running `kubectl get hpa -n inference` and checking queue depth.

Maya_s: Do we have confirmed customer impact (status page)? Any 5xx customer-facing errors?

incident-bot: Customer impact: a subset of requests are timing out; we have customer-facing 504s and elevated tail latency for streamed responses. Affected routes: /v1/generate (multi-token).

Evelyn_t: Owner = @evelyn_t. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) scale an additional pool on gpux2, 2) enable prefix KV cache for hot models, 3) fallback to quantized variant if needed.

Jamal_r: Scaling started (`scale deploy/redwood-runtime --replicas=12`). Watching queue depth. Also toggled faster eviction on KV cache.

Luis_f: Drafting status page now. Suggest short update: "Investigating elevated inference latencies in us-east affecting some requests. We are mitigating and will provide updates every 15 minutes."

Priya_k: +1 on status. Add note to mention potential degraded throughput for batch endpoints.

Evelyn_t: Taking the status page action. Posting now. Ping ops for customer comm review.

Jamal_r: Observability: tradeoff look — increasing replicas reduces latency but spikes costs. For now keep scale-up while we validate the KV change.

Maya_s: Are we routing traffic off us-east to eu-west as fallback?

Evelyn_t: Not yet; prefer warm scale first. If we don't see improvement in 10m, switch routing policy to route new requests to eu-west (canary).

Jamal_r: KV change shows immediate improvement on a few samples. 95p down from 2.3s -> 1.1s. Error rate slowly trending down.

incident-bot: Reminder: create a customer notification if impact persists >30m.

Luis_f: I'll prep the customer email template and hold until Evelyn confirms scope.

Evelyn_t: Confirmed — impact limited to subset of heavy batch customers (estimated 8 accounts). I'll DM CS to prep targeted outreach.

Priya_k: Oncall handoff note: Night oncall @carl_n takes shift at 23:00 UTC. If still degraded at handoff we'll run a warm transfer with logs and actions.

Evelyn_t: Acknowledged. Will leave runbook + mitigation checklist in the warroom pad and scribe summary for handoff.

Maya_s: Good job. Keep updates short in-thread; if anything changes ping #eng-oncall directly.

Evelyn_t: Posting final for this cycle: latency improving, errors decreasing, keeping scale-up for now. Next update in 15m or earlier if regress.

Luis_f: I'll take postmortem scribe once we stabilize. Adding a note to the incident ticket. :memo:
